# Sandustry Modding Documentation

> Community-maintained Sandkit API v1 documentation for creating Sandustry mods.

## Preferred AI context

- [Complete Sandustry modding context](./llms-full.txt): Give this single document to an AI before asking it to create, review, debug, or explain a Sandustry mod.

## Focused references

- [Practical AI guide](./ai-context.md): Core rules, workflow, examples, and reliability guidance.
- [Sandkit API reference](./apireference.md): Exact main-entry and worker-entry method signatures.
- [Mod folder structure](./modstructure.md): Manifest and package layout.
- [Textures and configuration](./textureconfig.md): Config and texture overrides.
- [Bundle patching](./patching.md): Patch schema and safety controls.
- [Custom maps](./custommaps.md): Map manifest and blueprint configuration.
